VBD Analysis — Case Study

Scope

This is a vector-centred analysis of the VBD CDM. Vectors (Anopheles spp.) are the study subject; environmental, resistance, bionomics, and case data are all interpreted in relation to them.

Data availability

Show R code 
qa <- res$qa
if (!is.null(qa) && is.data.frame(qa$tables) && nrow(qa$tables) > 0) {
  qa$tables |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Rows returned by each query")
} else {
  note("No data availability summary available.")
}
Rows returned by each query
dataset n_records date_min date_max
locations 322
cases 747348 2015-01-01 2025-12-31
vectors 79 2015-01-01 2020-11-01
environment 4018 2015-01-01 2025-12-31
Show R code 
if (!isTRUE(res$cases_available)) {
  md("> **Note:** `fact_disease_case` contains no observed case rows for this ",
     "study area. Case-based analyses are reported as contextual only.\n")
}

Vector species composition and seasonality

Show R code 
vs <- res$vector_seasonal
if (!is.null(err_of(vs))) {
  note("Vector seasonal analysis did not run: ", err_of(vs))
} else if (is.data.frame(vs$composition) && nrow(vs$composition) > 0) {
  vs$composition |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Species composition")
} else {
  note("No species composition available.")
}
Species composition
species_name n_obs total_count share
Anopheles gambiae 16 32023 0.8245488
Anopheles funestus 17 6814 0.1754512
Show R code 
p <- abs_fig(res$fig_vector_seasonal)
if (length(p) >= 1 && file.exists(p[1])) {
  knitr::include_graphics(p[1])
} else {
  note("No vector seasonal figure available.")
}

Vector–climate associations

Show R code 
vc <- res$vector_climate
if (!is.null(err_of(vc))) {
  note("Vector–climate analysis did not run: ", err_of(vc))
} else if (is.data.frame(vc$correlations) && nrow(vc$correlations) > 0) {
  vc$correlations |> gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Pearson correlations (monthly)")
} else {
  note("No vector–climate correlations available.")
}
Pearson correlations (monthly)
climate_variable r p n ci_lower ci_upper p_adj
2t 0.03771255 0.8349458 33 -0.3096049 0.3761515 0.8349458
tp -0.22523358 0.2075802 33 -0.5277356 0.1279707 0.4151605
Show R code 
p <- file.path(fig_dir,
               glue("{cfg$study_name}_vector_climate_correlations.png"))
if (file.exists(p)) knitr::include_graphics(p)
Show R code 
vc <- res$vector_climate
if (!is.null(err_of(vc)) || is.null(vc$climate_variables)) {
  note("No per-variable figures available.")
} else {
  for (v in vc$climate_variables) {
    p <- file.path(fig_dir,
                   glue("{cfg$study_name}_vector_climate_{v}.png"))
    if (file.exists(p)) {
      md(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", v))
      knitr::include_graphics(p)
    }
  }
}

Insecticide resistance

Show R code 
rs <- res$resistance_summary
if (!is.null(err_of(rs))) {
  note("Resistance analysis did not run: ", err_of(rs))
} else if (is.data.frame(rs$status_by_class) && nrow(rs$status_by_class) > 0) {
  rs$status_by_class |> gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Resistance status by chemical class")
} else {
  note("No classified resistance status available.")
}
Resistance status by chemical class
chemical_class resistance_status n share
pyrethroid Resistant 15 0.6521739
pyrethroid Susceptible 4 0.1739130
pyrethroid Suspected Resistance 4 0.1739130
Show R code 
p <- abs_fig(res$fig_resistance)
if (length(p) >= 1 && file.exists(p[1])) {
  knitr::include_graphics(p[1])
} else {
  note("No resistance figure available.")
}

Vector bionomics

Show R code 
bs <- res$bionomics_summary
if (!is.null(err_of(bs))) {
  note("Bionomics analysis did not run: ", err_of(bs))
} else {
  labels <- c(
    feeding    = "Feeding preference",
    biting_loc = "Biting location",
    resting    = "Resting behaviour",
    larval     = "Larval site type"
  )
  any_shown <- FALSE
  for (nm in names(labels)) {
    df <- bs[[nm]]
    if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      md(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", labels[[nm]]))
      print(gt::gt(df))
      any_shown <- TRUE
    }
  }
  if (!any_shown) {
    note("No bionomics distributions available.")
  }
}

  border-collapse: collapse;
  line-height: normal;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  color: #333333;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  background-color: #FFFFFF;
  width: auto;
  border-top-style: solid;
  border-top-width: 2px;
  border-top-color: #A8A8A8;
  border-right-style: none;
  border-right-width: 2px;
  border-right-color: #D3D3D3;
  border-bottom-style: solid;
  border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-bottom-color: #A8A8A8;
  border-left-style: none;
  border-left-width: 2px;
  border-left-color: #D3D3D3;
}

#lywnekntlf .gt_caption {
  padding-top: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}

#lywnekntlf .gt_title {
  color: #333333;
  font-size: 125%;
  font-weight: initial;
  padding-top: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  padding-left: 5px;
  padding-right: 5px;
  border-bottom-color: #FFFFFF;
  border-bottom-width: 0;
}

#lywnekntlf .gt_subtitle {
  color: #333333;
  font-size: 85%;
  font-weight: initial;
  padding-top: 3px;
  padding-bottom: 5px;
  padding-left: 5px;
  padding-right: 5px;
  border-top-color: #FFFFFF;
  border-top-width: 0;
}

#lywnekntlf .gt_heading {

  text-align: center;
  border-bottom-color: #FFFFFF;

  border-right-style: none;
  border-right-width: 1px;
  border-right-color: #D3D3D3;
}

  border-bottom-color: #D3D3D3;
}

Interventions

Show R code 
iv <- res$intervention_summary
if (!is.null(err_of(iv))) {
  note("Intervention summary did not run: ", err_of(iv))
} else if (is.data.frame(iv$by_type) && nrow(iv$by_type) > 0) {
  iv$by_type |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Interventions by type")
} else {
  note("No interventions recorded for this study area.")
}

Impact on disease burden

Show R code 
ib <- res$intervention_burden
if (!is.null(err_of(ib))) {
  note("Intervention–burden analysis did not run: ", err_of(ib))
} else if (is.data.frame(ib$by_type) && nrow(ib$by_type) > 0) {
  ib$by_type |> gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Pre/post change in cases by intervention type")
} else {
  note("No usable pre/post comparisons for case data.")
}

Case data (context)

Show R code 
if (!isTRUE(res$cases_available)) {
  note("No observed case rows are present in the CDM for this study area.")
} else {
  md("Observed case rows available: **", res$cases_n, "**.\n")
  se <- res$seasonal
  if (!is.null(err_of(se))) {
    note("Case seasonality analysis did not run: ", err_of(se))
  } else if (is.data.frame(se$monthly) && nrow(se$monthly) > 0) {
    se$monthly |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Case seasonality")
  } else {
    note("Case rows present but insufficient for seasonal summary.")
  }
}
